full_prompt_en: A square dramatic color close-up shows a performer in elaborate red, white, and black face makeup against a nearly black background. The face fills the center-left of the frame and is tilted slightly downward, with narrow eyes looking sideways beneath heavily painted dark brows. A broad white area curves over the nose and cheek, while deep crimson panels surround the eyes and sweep toward the temples. Fine black scrolls and sharp painted points trace the forehead and eye corners. The lips are dark red and closed, giving the expression a controlled intensity. On the far left, a black glossy gloved hand rises beside the cheek, its fingers vertical and slightly curved. Dark costume fabric and a red-edged fold frame the lower face, merging with the shadow behind it. The forehead reaches the upper edge, and the lower chin is cropped by the close composition. A small amount of pale skin-like texture remains visible under the pigment, making the makeup look physical rather than like a perfectly flat mask. Focus is strongest on the eye, nose, lips, and glove, while the background stays indistinct. Directional light from the upper left catches the white nose and cheek, glances across the glove, and leaves the other side of the face in deep shade. The red paint appears matte with fine grain; the glove reflects narrower, wetter highlights. The close framing leaves little empty space, so the contrast of rigid painted shapes and the curved hand dominates the image. There is no readable lettering or visible setting beyond the dark stage-like field. The overall composition is tense and richly graphic, using sharp red-black geometry, sculpted white planes, and selective highlights to build theatrical presence.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形戏剧性彩色特写呈现一名表演者，脸上画着繁复的红、白、黑妆，背景近乎黑色。脸占据中央偏左，并略向下倾；细长眼睛在浓重的深色画眉下向侧方望去。宽阔白色区域弯过鼻梁与面颊，深红色块包围双眼并扫向太阳穴。细黑卷纹与尖锐画线沿额头和眼角延伸。暗红嘴唇紧闭，让表情带有受控的强度。最左侧，一只黑色光亮手套抬到脸颊旁，手指竖直并稍微弯曲。深色戏服布料和一道红边衣褶围住下半张脸，融入身后阴影。额头抵达上缘，下巴则被紧凑取景裁断。颜料之下仍有少许皮肤般细微纹理，使妆容显得有实体，而非完全平坦的面具。焦点在眼、鼻、唇与手套处最清楚，背景保持模糊。定向光从左上方照来，抓住白色鼻梁和面颊，掠过手套，使脸的另一侧落入深影。红色颜料呈带细颗粒的哑光质感；手套则反射更窄、更湿亮的高光。近距离取景几乎不留空处，因此刚硬的画妆形状与弯曲的手支配画面。没有可读文字，也看不见深色舞台般底域之外的具体场景。整体构图紧张而图形感丰富，以锐利红黑几何、雕塑般白色平面和选择性高光塑造戏剧气场。
style_prompt_en: The color image sets saturated crimson, chalky white, and glossy black in a compressed, high-contrast range. Sharp ornamental lines and broad painted fields work together: thin curls articulate the edges while uninterrupted light planes give the main form sculptural volume. Most surroundings fall to near-black, so a few precise highlights and an intense colored region carry the visual hierarchy. Matte pigment and glossier material reflect light differently, adding tactile distinction inside the narrow palette. Close cropping removes contextual distance and makes small changes in edge hardness feel dramatic. Directional light favors one side and lets the opposite side merge with the background. The composition is dense rather than spacious, with curved dark accents countering angular painted marks. The overall effect is theatrical and controlled, built from graphic color separation, surface contrast, and selective illumination.
style_prompt_zh: 这种彩色画面把饱和深红、粉白与亮黑置于压缩的高对比色域。锐利装饰线与宽阔涂绘色面共同作用：细卷线刻画边缘，连续亮面则给予主要形体雕塑般体积。周围大多落入近黑，因此少量精确高光和一片强烈色域就足以承载视觉主次。哑光颜料与较光亮材料以不同方式反光，在狭窄配色中增加可触的区别。紧凑裁切移去环境距离，使边缘软硬的细小变化都显得戏剧化。定向光偏向一侧，另一侧则融入背景。构图密集而非宽敞，弯曲深色重音对照棱角分明的涂绘痕迹。整体效果戏剧性而受控，由图形化色彩分离、表面质感对比和选择性照明构成。
theme_en: A theatrical face in red, white, and black makeup beside a gloved hand
theme_zh: 一张红白黑脸谱的戏剧性面孔，旁边举着戴手套的手
name: Kabuki
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
